inicio.title: DECODICA
inicio.description1: *DecoDica* is a super versatile party/social game that can be played in 5 different ways, where players are challenged to work their creativity, speed and interpretation.
inicio.description2: DecoDica is a collab with *Forja Game Studio.*

goal.title: General Goal
goal.item1: Work different skills in each of the following game modes.

goalD.title: Goal
goalD.item1: Work on persuasion by creating the best association between random words and win the votes of the competitors.

preparation.title: Preparation
preparation.item1: Shuffle all cards to form the draw pile

generalRules.title: General rules
generalRules.item1: The first player must draw two cards and place them in the center of the table.
generalRules.item2: Starting with them, each player must make any association - there are no rules or limits, but remember you must convince the other players that yours was the best.
generalRules.item3: If more than one player wants to make an association, preference goes to the player who drew the cards, then the order follows the game direction.
generalRules.item4: Any player can choose not to participate.

endRound.title: End of round
endRound.item1: After all players who wish to have made their association, everyone must simultaneously vote for the best association by pointing to the player who made it.
endRound.item2: Voting for yourself or blank votes are not allowed.
endRound.item3: After voting, the next player draws new cards and starts a new round.

score.title: Scoring
score.item1: The most voted player wins 1 point, represented by the two associated cards.
score.item2: In case of a tie, the tied players compete in a round only between them, with all other players voting for the best association.

endGame.title: End of game
endGame.item1: When a player reaches 3 points, they become the winner, thus ending the game.

goalD.title: Goal
goalD.item1: Work on your creativity by giving personality to objects and describing how they would behave as a person. But don't be obvious, because you don't score if everyone gets it right...

preparation.title: Preparation
preparation.item1: Shuffle all cards and distribute them in a 3x3 grid, the remainder stays separate in the draw pile.

generalRules.title: General rules

item1.title: Each player, on their turn, must choose a card to personify. The player should start by telling a little about it:

steps.1: 1. They are a person very beloved by everyone
steps.2: 2. They really enjoy listening to music
steps.3: 3. They are a person who loves the city

generalRules.item2: Anything you believe the card would do as a person, while the other players can ask questions.
generalRules.item3: Answers should always relate to the card, be careful not to stray too far, because someone still needs to guess correctly.

endRound.title: End of round
endRound.item1: The round lasts 3 minutes, players should count this time while asking questions and the player describes the card.
endRound.item2: After 3 minutes, players must vote on which card they believe is being personified.
endRound.item3: After that, a new grid is set up for the next player to start their round.

score.title: Scoring
score.item1: If all players guess wrong, no one scores.
score.item2: If all players guess correctly, each player who guesses correctly gets 1 card from the grid. The describer gets nothing.
score.item3: If some people guess wrong and others right, the player who described receives two cards from the grid and the others who guessed correctly receive 1 card.

endGame.title: End of game
endGame.item1: When all players have personified 2 cards, the player who received the most cards will be the winner. In case of a tie, the players share the victory.

goalD.title: Goal
goalD.item1: Work on your strategy by making the best combination on the table with the cards in your hand.

preparation.title: Preparation
preparation.item1: Shuffle all cards, deal 5 to each player and place the remainder in the draw pile.
preparation.item2: Then reveal one card and leave another card revealed on top of the draw pile.

generalRules.title: General rules
generalRules.item1: The first player must use one of their cards to make an association with the drawn card. In game order, each other player will do the same, always combining with the card that was drawn at the beginning of the round.
generalRules.item2: The card on top of the draw pile will be the card for the next round, players can observe this card to create strategies about the next cards they will use.

endRound.title: End of round
endRound.item1: When all players have played their cards, players must then vote simultaneously, pointing to the card of the player who made the best association.
endRound.item2: Voting for yourself or blank votes are not allowed.
endRound.item3: At the end of voting, the card from the draw pile is placed on the table, players replenish their hand cards until they have 5, a new card is revealed on top of the draw pile and the new round begins with the next player in the game direction.

score.title: Scoring
score.item1: The most voted player wins 1 point, represented by the two associated cards.
score.item2: In case of a tie, the tied players compete in a round only between them, with all other players voting for the best association. Whoever wins gets 1 point.

endGame.title: End of game
endGame.item1: When a player reaches 3 points, they become the winner, thus ending the game.

goalD.title: Goal
goalD.item1: Work on your improvisation by putting together the pieces of a far-fetched story and be the first to run out of cards in your hand.

preparation.title: Preparation
preparation.item1: Shuffle all cards, deal 5 to each player and place the remainder in the draw pile. Then reveal one card.

generalRules.title: General rules
generalRules.item1: There is no order, players must make associations with the cards in their hand and any card on the table, whether it's the initial card or a card played by another player.

steps.1: 1. You cannot play two cards in a row, you must wait for another player to make an association before you can make a new one.

endGame.title: End of game
endGame.item1: The game ends when a player uses all cards in their hand with valid associations, becoming the winner.

goalD.title: Goal
goalD.item1: Work on your memory by creating associations and remembering where the cards of associations made by other players are.

preparation.title: Preparation
preparation.item1: Shuffle all cards and distribute them in a 4x4 grid, the remainder stays separate in the draw pile.

generalRules.title: General rules
generalRules.item1: Players should take a moment to memorize the cards and create associations in their mind, always with 2 cards at a time. The time can be set by the table.
generalRules.item2: Then, the cards must be turned face down and one player must describe an association between 2 cards.
generalRules.item3: Following the game direction, each other player can turn over two cards to try to find those that represent the described association. The player who described must inform how many are correct.

endRound.title: End of round
endRound.item1: Players continue turning cards until someone gets both cards right or it returns to the player who made the association. At that point, the next player will have the chance to describe a new association.

score.title: Scoring
score.item1: When a player guesses the association correctly, both cards are removed from the grid, one for the guesser and one for the associator.

table.title: Refilling the table
table.item1: If half of the grid cards are removed, the cards should be turned face up and the grid should be completed with new cards.
table.item2: Players will have more time to make new associations and memorize the new grid.
table.item3: Then, turn the cards face down and continue the game from where it left off.

endGame.title: End of game
endGame.item1: When a player reaches 3 points, they become the winner, thus ending the game.
endGame.item2: In case of a tie, the players share the victory.
